title: Separate installed packages from archives
goal: Inspect installed ownership/status and dormant package metadata.
challenge: Find the package owning /usr/bin/cat and record its installed version/status. Inspect the trusted report archive's files and dependencies without installing it.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-discovery-5; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Create a fresh private workspace; stop on collision or insufficient space.
steps.expected: Exact learner path, no existing entry, at least64MiB free.

steps.command: guard() { local links; test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-discovery-5 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-discovery-5 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && links=$(sudo find . -type l -print -quit) && test -z "$links"; }; guard
steps.expected: No path substitution; guest root can override guest safeguards.

steps.command: unrelated() { dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${db:Status-Status}\n' | awk '$1!="ll-discovery-data" && $1!="ll-discovery-report"'; }; unrelated > before.tsv; sudo sha256sum /etc/sudoers.d/learning-lab > sudo.before; id learner > learner.before; scope_ok() { guard && unrelated > after.tsv && cmp before.tsv after.tsv && sudo sha256sum -c sudo.before && id learner > learner.after && cmp learner.before learner.after; }; scope_ok
steps.explanation: Retain unrelated package and learner/sudo evidence before any transaction.
steps.expected: Protected unrelated state captured; stop on mismatch.

steps.command: guard && { dpkg-query -S /usr/bin/cat; dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version} ${db:Status-Status}\n' coreutils; dpkg -L coreutils | head -n 8; } > package.txt && cat package.txt
steps.explanation: Package identity, executable name and installation status are distinct.
steps.expected: coreutils owns cat and is installed at the pinned version.

steps.explanation: An archive is not installed just because it is present.
steps.expected: Report metadata and its data/dash/coreutils dependency declaration.

steps.explanation: Read the declared payload before installing; only these reviewed packages are used.
steps.expected: Fixed regular files and directories; no maintainer scripts, links or services.

hints: dpkg-deb inspects the archive, not installed state.
A package's declared dependencies are not automatic proof of configuration.
review: Owner/version/status plus archive payload/dependency report; fixture remains uninstalled.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 102.4 partial package information/ownership. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
